notes.title: Apotheon 1.2 Multiplayer update
notes.notes:
Online multiplayer is now out of beta! We've added 4 new maps to it also, and fixed a number of online issues.

Note: Mac/Linux update will go live tonight/tomorrow

We will be releasing a free standalone version called 'Apotheon Arena' soon - so let us know any possible issues you have our forums.

So join a multiplayer game! Or start one and try out the bots

New maps:
- Ares
- Dionysus
- Garden
- Zeus

Changes:
- gamepad support for server selecting
- better bots
- fixed weird characters in Steam username crashing games
- fixed items only spawning on client when host was near

Thanks!
- Lee and Jesse

notes.title: Update 1.03
notes.notes:
- Added Aspis Shield to Agora/Acropolis shops
- Elevators in Ares open again after Ares death
- Added 4K resolution option
- Fixed Rare Item Achievement
- Fixed issue with reappearing gods (artemis/apollo/ares), and a crash in Apollo-upperpalace
- Fixed issue with Hunter key getting stuck in geometry
- Less particles in Hephaestus

Thanks for all the positive feedback everyone! This has been a pretty awesome launch
You can follow development on our Facebook and Twitter pages:
https://www.facebook.com/Alientrap
https://twitter.com/Alientrap
